cases.sentence: После этого царь Аманитян умер, и вместо него царем стал его ___.
cases.translation: After this the king of the Ammonites died, and his son became king in his place.
cases.explain: The nominative case is used for the predicate nominative after the verb стал.

cases.sentence: Давид подумал, «Я окажу ___,  сыну Нахаша, милость».
cases.translation: David thought, 'I will show kindness to Hanun, son of Nahash.'
cases.explain: The dative case marks the recipient or beneficiary of an action.

cases.sentence: Давид отправил к ___  своих слуг, чтобы выразить соболезнование о его отце.
cases.translation: David sent his servants to Hanun to express condolences about his father.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to) governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Когда люди Давида пришли в ___ Аманитян.
cases.translation: When David's men came to the land of the Ammonites.
cases.explain: The preposition в (into) indicating direction of movement takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Ханун сбрил им половину бороды и отрезав их одежды наполовину и отослал их из ___.
cases.translation: Hanun shaved off half their beards and cut off their garments and sent them away from the city.
cases.explain: The preposition из (from) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Когда об этом рассказали Давиду, он послал им навстречу ___ из Иерихона.
cases.translation: When David heard this, he sent people to meet them from Jericho.
cases.explain: The accusative case marks the direct object of the verb послал.

cases.sentence: Ханун сказал вождям, «Давид хочет избежать войны с ___».
cases.translation: Hanun said to his leaders, 'David wants to avoid war with Hanun.'
cases.explain: The instrumental case follows the preposition с (with).

cases.sentence: После этого Иоав со своими воинами вступил в сражение с ___.
cases.translation: After this Joab and his men engaged the Syrians in battle.
cases.explain: The instrumental case marks the entity one fights with (the preposition с meaning 'with').

reading.ru: После этого царь Аманитян умер, и вместо него царем стал его сын Ханун.
reading.question: Who became king after the king of the Ammonites died?
reading.explain: The text states that when the Ammonite king died, his son Hanun became king in his place.

reading.ru: Давид подумал, «Я окажу Хануну, сыну Нахаша, милость, как его отец оказал милость мне».
reading.question: Why did David decide to show kindness to Hanun?
options: Because Hanun's father had shown him kindness
Because he wanted to conquer Ammon
To gain allies against other enemies
reading.correct: Because Hanun's father had shown him kindness
reading.explain: David explicitly says he will show kindness to Hanun as his father (Nahash) had shown kindness to David.

reading.ru: Ханун схватил людей Давида, сбрил им половину бороды и отрезав их одежды наполовину до ягодиц, и отослал их обратно.
reading.question: How did Hanun treat David's messengers?
options: He shaved half their beards and cut their garments in half, then sent them back
He treated them with great honor
He sent them back with gifts
reading.correct: He shaved half their beards and cut their garments in half, then sent them back
reading.explain: The text explicitly describes Hanun's disrespectful treatment of David's messengers in this manner.

reading.ru: Царь сказал, «Оставайтесь в Иерихоне, пока не отрастут ваши бороды, а потом возвращайтесь».
reading.question: What did David tell his embarrassed messengers to do?
options: Stay in Jericho until their beards grow back, then return
reading.correct: Stay in Jericho until their beards grow back, then return
reading.explain: David instructed his messengers to remain in Jericho until their beards had regrown before returning to him.

reading.ru: Когда аммонитяне поняли, что сделали с ненавистными Давиду, они наняли двадцать тысяч пеших воинов из Арам-Бетрехова и Арам-Цовы.
reading.question: What did the Ammonites do after realizing their insult?
options: Hired twenty thousand foot soldiers from various Syrian regions
reading.correct: Hired twenty thousand foot soldiers from various Syrian regions
reading.explain: After seeing what they had done to David's messengers, the Ammonites hired Syrian mercenaries to prepare for war.

reading.ru: Иав сказал, «Если арамеи станут одолевать меня, то ты придешь ко мне на помощь, а если аманитяне станут одолевать тебя, то я приду к тебе на помощь».
reading.question: What battle plan did Joab propose to Abishai?
options: They would help each other if either was being overwhelmed in battle
They would attack from opposite sides
They would retreat together if threatened
reading.correct: They would help each other if either was being overwhelmed in battle
reading.explain: Joab's plan was that if the Syrians overpowered him, Abishai would come to help, and vice versa if the Ammonites overpowered Abishai.
